title: What a junior role actually is, and what the advert means by it

videos.script: Almost every job you will apply for says junior somewhere, and it means less than it seems. {{word}} It does not mean you know a little of everything. It means you can be handed a small piece of work, you will finish it, and you will ask when you are stuck. {{means}} The advert around it is harder to read. It lists ten requirements, and the company would hire somebody who had six. {{advert}} This lesson reads a junior advert line by line, separates what they need from what they would like, and sets out the titles you will meet in Brazil and elsewhere.
